# Gamma pipeline audit — STAGE B results

Disk only; no database. Source `fix/audit/runs.csv` (8,595 rows), built by `run_stage_b.py` over `fix/replay_v2/chain/`. P = production replica, N = proposed (one vendor gamma per strike), R = reference (replay v2 per-strike own gamma). **No spot²/1e7 factor**: these are raw gamma×OI sums, not Crore.

## Addition 1 — what the 128 files are

| symbol | files | first date | last date | files with ≥1 market run | files with zero market runs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| NIFTY | 64 | 2026-08-25 | 2026-11-20 | 58 | 6 |
| SENSEX | 64 | 2026-08-25 | 2026-11-20 | 58 | 6 |

Zero-market-run dates (identical on both symbols): 2026-08-25, 2026-09-14, 2026-10-02, 2026-10-20, 2026-10-21, 2026-11-10.

128 files = **64 distinct dates × 2 symbols**. The frozen design names 58 days in 2026-08-24..2026-11-20; the files hold 64 dates, of which **6 per symbol carry no market run**, leaving exactly **58 days per symbol with data** — the design's 58.

**No file lies outside 2026-08-24..2026-11-20** (earliest file 2026-08-25, latest 2026-11-20), so the rule is evaluated on all of them and there is nothing to report separately. Note the design window opens 2026-08-24 but no file exists for that date: the chain pull began 2026-08-25.

Of the six zero-market-run dates, five (2026-08-25, 09-14, 10-20, 10-21, 11-10) are the empty weekdays the replay v2 pull already logged OK_EMPTY. The sixth, **2026-10-02, is different**: that file does carry rows, but none inside 09:15–15:29 IST. It is the registered holiday `HOLIDAY-FROZEN-CHAIN-2026-10-02` (Rule 13), whose chain was written from the previous session's post-close prints.

## Section 6 rule — applied verbatim

N is BETTER than P for a symbol when **all four** hold on the all-strikes figures: (1) mean and median of E_raw(N) both lower than E_raw(P); (2) mean and median of E_shape(N) both lower; (3) mean and median of |T_N−T_R| both lower; (4) on runs where R's lead ≥ 5 %, N's agreement with R is not lower than P's on BOTH peaks of N5. Overall BETTER only if all four hold for BOTH symbols. Clause 4 is read peak by peak: the positive peak is judged on runs with `lead_R_pos ≥ 0.05`, the abs peak on runs with `lead_R_abs ≥ 0.05`.

| symbol | clause | P | N | holds |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| NIFTY | 1 E_raw | mean 0.075396, median 0.0666447 | mean 0.0385672, median 0.0355861 | YES |
| NIFTY | 2 E_shape | mean 0.0770432, median 0.0675368 | mean 0.038588, median 0.0361982 | YES |
| NIFTY | 3 |T−T_R| | mean 0.0623073, median 0.0515087 | mean 0.0351221, median 0.0336193 | YES |
